name: 816800.xyz
description: A free, static streaming test bench that runs entirely in the browser. Its centre is an M3U8/HLS and DASH stream tester built on hls.js and dash.js that diagnoses why playback failed, separating an unreachable URL from a missing Access-Control-Allow-Origin header; alongside it is a static URL shortener for long stream links. No upload, no account, no tracking.

technical.stack: Static HTML, hand-written CSS, no framework and no build step
technical.dataProcessing: Client-side only; no server-side storage of user input
technical.analytics: Aggregate analytics only (Google Analytics 4); no advertising or behavioural tracking cookies
